metaTitle: Custom 13 oz Coffee Mugs | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom 13 oz coffee mugs for your team or event. Perfect for morning brews. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 13 oz coffee mugs hit the sweet spot between a standard 12 oz and a larger 16 oz mug, giving your team or clients a generous serving of their morning coffee without the extra weight. Whether you're outfitting an office breakroom with durable ceramic or choosing insulated stainless steel for on-the-go commuters, this size works with most single-serve brewers. Decorate with your logo using full-color imprint or classic engraving for a professional finish that stands up to daily use.
heroAltText: Custom 13 oz coffee mugs with company logo in ceramic and stainless steel options
